description_short: For each application (luminescence, memory, gate dielectrics, electrolytes, etc.), count how many distinct host materials are reported per rare-earth dopant in comparison R1469955, and identify the most versatile dopants within each application.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

postprocessing_notes.aggregation: The query groups by application and dopant, counting distinct host materials per group (n_hosts) to reveal versatile dopants (many hosts) versus more specialized dopants (few hosts) within each functional category.
